title: Vibes

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Hey, hey, why you moving so fast?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, hey, why you moving so fast?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Everyone's always got somewhere to be, somewhere they're always rushing off to. Gotta chill my people. Chill and enjoy the music.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone's always got somewhere to be, somewhere they're always rushing off to. Gotta chill my people. Chill and enjoy the music.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Lil' ole me? Though I'm not so little I 'spose. Haha, just an extra layer of warmth come the rainy times. But me? I'm the one, the only, Flippin' Finn Amano!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lil' ole me? Though I'm not so little I 'spose. Haha, just an extra layer of warmth come the rainy times. But me? I'm the one, the only, Flippin' Finn Amano!

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: That's just too damn bad... Wait... It's too damn bad, that this world is so sad, so rushed... just to gush... over nothing but mad, mad ol' mush...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's just too damn bad... Wait... It's too damn bad, that this world is so sad, so rushed... just to gush... over nothing but mad, mad ol' mush...

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: If the airwaves were kinder, and the scene a little brighter, we'd be flying higher, flying higher.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the airwaves were kinder, and the scene a little brighter, we'd be flying higher, flying higher.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Fair. What's fair is fair and what's not is, well, just something to figure out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair. What's fair is fair and what's not is, well, just something to figure out.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Me? I'm on nothing but the high of life. People might say otherwise but that's it. Just riding the vibes 'til I die.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? I'm on nothing but the high of life. People might say otherwise but that's it. Just riding the vibes 'til I die.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Life is what you put into it. Luckily, the currency of that ideology is perspective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Life is what you put into it. Luckily, the currency of that ideology is perspective.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ah, you want the secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, you want the secret.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: There are no drugs. Everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are no drugs. Everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Real music comes from real life. Shared experiences and common emotions. Only way to harness that vibe is to live in it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Real music comes from real life. Shared experiences and common emotions. Only way to harness that vibe is to live in it.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows to, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows to, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port. Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me, people on the move. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port. Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me, people on the move. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.
